chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhl narrated from Harun ibn Muslim from Mas'adah ibn Sadah from Abu Abdillah from his father, peace be upon them, that Ali (peace be upon him) said:
"Fast on Ashura - the ninth and the tenth, for it expiates the sins of a year."

key_terms.الْعَاشُورَاءَ: Ashura, the tenth day of the month of Muharram

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of fasting on the day of Ashura according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Transmitted through the chain of Shaykh al-Tusi in *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith highlights the dual fasting of the 9th and 10th of Muharram (Tasua and Ashura) as a means of expiating minor sins for the preceding year. This practice distinguishes Shia tradition from Sunni practice by emphasizing the addition of the 9th day to ensure accuracy in lunar sighting and to differentiate from the Jewish tradition of fasting solely on the 10th.
